title: Three-way care, a jackal’s feast
odia:
ତିନି ଥେଣ୍ଟିଆ କାକୁଡି ଭାଡି
ଶିଆଳ ଖାଏ ମୋଡି ମାଡି।
literal_meaning: A cucumber trellis under three-way care; a jackal eats, twisting and trampling.
meaning_odia: ତିନିଜଣଙ୍କ ଦେଖାଶୁଣାରେ ଥିବା କାକୁଡ଼ି ଭାଡ଼ିକୁ ଶିଆଳ ମୋଡ଼ିମାଡ଼ି ଖାଉଛି—ଏହି ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଧାଡ଼ିକୁ ଏଭଳି ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ଅନେକଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ଥାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଖାଶୁଣା ଠିକ୍ ନହେଲେ ସମ୍ପଦ ନଷ୍ଟ ହୋଇପାରେ।
explanation: The crop is exposed to a jackal despite apparently having three-way care. Read editorially, the contrast concerns responsibility shared without effective protection. The rendering of ଥେଣ୍ଟିଆ is contextual: a related public expression describes three guardians, while this upload retains ଭାଡି, a raised support, rather than the public expression’s word for a garden.
usage_example: Original imagined example: Three teams share responsibility for checking a store, but none makes the inspection. After supplies are spoiled, someone recalls the cucumber trellis and the jackal.
cultural_context: The jackal does more than take a neat share: the repeated actions suggest eating amid twisting and trampling. The image makes neglected protection visible as damage to a crop.

witnesses.locator: Page22, first item beginning ତିନି ଥେଣ୍ଟିଆ.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected17November2026. Missing ଣ୍ଟ cluster restored using the documented underlying PDF character mapping. Exact ଭାଡି retained. Three-way care and cucumber trellis are contextual renderings; the compound’s exact lexical formation remains uncertain. A partial public counterpart uses ବାଡ଼ି, not ଭାଡି.

origin_note: Full wording attested in the uploaded unattributed compilation. An indexed public fragment supplies a related cucumber-garden expression, not the complete verse. Earliest origin and shared lineage unknown.

odia_summary: ଭାଗ ହୋଇଥିବା ଦାୟିତ୍ୱରେ ଦେଖାଶୁଣା ଅବହେଳିତ ହେଲେ କ୍ଷତି ହୋଇପାରେ।
english_summary: Shared responsibility can still leave something unprotected.
